units.source_text: 照子的新婚房屋在城镇和大葱地的交接地带，那附近以新建的出租房为主，房子盖得很是密集。

en.t: Teruko's newlywed home stood where the town met the green onion fields, in an area crowded with newly built rental houses.

units.source_text: 每家每户的构造都差不多，包括带檐的大门，光叶石楠篱笆，甚至晾晒衣服的竹竿都没什么差别。

en.t: Every house was built in much the same way, with no real difference even in the eaved gates, the photinia hedges, or the bamboo poles for drying laundry.

units.source_text: 新房子这么普通，信子心里有点失望。

en.t: Because the new house was so ordinary, Nobuko felt a little disappointed.
